en: Colorized industrial-era postcard showing a large factory complex with tall red brick smokestacks beside a body of water and low rolling hills in the background. The main building is a long red brick structure with multiple tall chimneys, surrounded by smaller stone and metal-roofed industrial buildings, scaffolding, and construction materials. At the top of the image there is red printed text reading "POZDRAV IZ SOLINA, Adria Portland."
